advisories.title: g22.doesNotClaim recites namingStanding as NAMED-NOT-QUALIFIED while the field itself holds NAMED-NOT-AUTHORED-NOT-QUALIFIED
advisories.observation: The field /g22/namingStanding holds the token 'NAMED-NOT-AUTHORED-NOT-QUALIFIED'. The sentence in /g22/doesNotClaim reads 'namingStanding remains NAMED-NOT-QUALIFIED', naming a different token. I traced the lineage: namingStanding has held NAMED-NOT-AUTHORED-NOT-QUALIFIED continuously since v2, and the shorthand entered doesNotClaim at v33 when the PTCB-V32-ADV1 repair rewrote that string so it would no longer begin with the token QUALIFIED. The abbreviation has been carried through sixteen successors, v33 to v48, without a reviewer raising it. The full token is the one that tracks the live register: file 08 line 358, the DR-G22 PLATFORM-ABI-LOADER row, records 'named: harness.DR-G22.platform-abi-loader (D-086; not authored; not QUALIFIED)', so 'not authored' is a recorded property that the shorthand drops.
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: The recited token is entailed by the held token rather than in conflict with it: NAMED-NOT-AUTHORED-NOT-QUALIFIED is NAMED and is NOT-QUALIFIED. The operative proposition of the sentence, that this subject does not QUALIFY G22, is true of the bytes and is independently stated at /whatThisDoesNotDo/5 and /authorityClaim. Nothing selects on the doesNotClaim string. /g22 is not on the v48 closed roster, so editing it at this successor would itself be the roster violation the attack list names; this is the same disposition CLAUDE-V47-A3 reached on the reMeasurementAtV2-through-V5 asymmetry, which this successor then landed on a round whose roster named those paths.
advisories.suggestedDisposition: Optional, on a later round whose closed roster names /g22/doesNotClaim: recite the held token in full, or drop the recital and let /g22/namingStanding speak for itself.
advisories.notAFinding: Records a carried token asymmetry only. It names no selector value, no Apple key, no build string and no table row. It does not reserve my grade answer.

advisories.title: The 'remeasurement' spelling-residue disposition scopes the residues to pre-v12 honesty ledgers, but six remasurement notes and one governingSources role also carry them, three of those notes post-v12
advisories.observation: notFoldedThisSuccessor[1] reads 'Historical remasurement/remeasurement spelling residues in pre-v12 honesty ledgers remain historical text.' I enumerated every occurrence of the string 'remeasurement' in the subject. Two are in pre-v12 honesty ledgers, honestyRepairsFromV7[5] and honestyRepairsFromV11[7], which is the disclosed scope. Six more are in remasurement-block notes, at V6, V7, V11, V15, V16 and V17; V15, V16 and V17 are post-v12. One more is in /recordedInputs/governingSources/1/role, which is a v1-era pin annotation, not a honesty ledger. The distribution is not a clean pre/post-v12 boundary in either direction: V8, V9, V10, V12, V13 and V14 already spell 'remasurement'. So the disposition line, read as the residue inventory, under-describes both where the residues sit and how many there are.
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: The line makes no false statement about the entries it names, and it is a not-folded disposition over a class rather than an exhaustive inventory; it does not say 'only'. Nothing operative keys on the prose spelling. The live-block resolution rule keys on the machine-readable 'standing' member, and I verified that member is uniform and unambiguous across all 47 blocks: exactly one LIVE, at reMeasurementAtV48, and V2 through V47 each carrying HISTORICAL-AT-VN with N equal to their own index. Every one of the eight residue sites is off the v48 closed roster, so repairing them here would be a roster violation. I note in the subject's favour that the four notes this successor newly authored, at V2 through V5, use the current 'remasurement' spelling rather than propagating the residue.
advisories.suggestedDisposition: Optional, on a later round whose roster names those paths: either widen the disposition sentence to the true residue inventory, or normalize the eight sites and retire the disposition.
advisories.notAFinding: Records a prose-inventory scope gap only. It names nothing reserved, populates nothing, and does not reserve my grade answer.
